name: Manas Ranjan Mahapatra / ମାନସ ରଂଜନ ମହାପାତ୍ର

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Manas Ranjan Mahapatra is an Odia poet, fiction writer, translator and editor whose literary life remains closely connected with Puri. His work at the National Book Trust included the National Centre for Children’s Literature. In a 2021 interview, he described editing as a commitment to other writers that also sharpened his scrutiny of his own work. His books include the story collection Unit Tinira Premika and the novel Nihsanga.

In ‘ଦିନେ ଫେରିବାବେଳେ ଅନ୍ଧାରରେ’, a friend’s warning about the dangers of walking home in darkness becomes an unexpected argument. The speaker answers that daylight holds wounds of its own, turning a familiar exchange into a terse meditation on human hurt. Its conversational opening and ironic reversal give a small scene a wider moral reach.
